what: In a dark section, when you hover a menu row, the section background tints to that row’s color in .3s, and the panel paired with that row (one or two photos, or a video with bracketed text) rises in .4s. On leave, the background returns to its original color in .3s and the panel fades out in .4s — a photo studio menu where sweeping across the menu turns the whole section a different light per row

options.panel-dur: Time (s) for the panel to rise and fade out, default .4
options.[data-fx-part=item]: Row that reacts to hover — give style --fx-tint (that row’s background color, made from skin variables)
options.[data-fx-part=panel]: (If present) panels paired in row order — off at first

note: Does not stick on devices without a hand (touch) — phones show it separately as slides (knot)

from.where: index.html menu section (original [data-top-menu] — on link mouseenter the section bg goes to data-color in .3s, the paired .top-menu__bg in .4s. The panel also has a CSS opacity transition .5s cubic-bezier(.215,.61,.355,1), so the measured length is ~.65s — the copy has the same transition in its page css too)
